description: Structured manifest of all input fields, scoring variables, and classification logic for the IFS (Impact-Feasibility-Scalability) AI Prioritization Framework

step1_setContext.description: Organizational context fields that frame all prioritization decisions

contextTitle.label: Context Title
contextTitle.description: A short, descriptive name for this prioritization context

clientContext.label: Client Context
clientContext.placeholder: Describe the client organization: industry, size, current systems, strategic goals...
clientContext.description: Holistic description of the organization's industry, size, current state, and strategic objectives

resourceCapacity.label: Resource Capacity
resourceCapacity.description: Available resources for AI initiative delivery

spaceKey.label: Jira Space Key
spaceKey.description: Jira project key for MCP integration (auto-populates workspace context)

step2_defineInitiative.description: Initiative-specific fields for the AI use case being evaluated

jiraKey.label: Jira Issue Key
jiraKey.description: Jira issue key for MCP data retrieval

initiativeTitle.label: Initiative Title
initiativeTitle.description: Concise name for the AI initiative

useCaseDescription.label: AI Initiative Description
useCaseDescription.placeholder: Describe the AI-powered capability, what it automates, and the expected outcome...
useCaseDescription.description: Detailed description of the AI use case and its intended outcomes

prioritizationContext.label: Prioritization Context
prioritizationContext.description: Supplementary context specific to this initiative's prioritization

workType.label: Work Type
workType.description: Classification of initiative type - Activation (direct value) or Enablement (foundational infrastructure)

makes10xFaster.label: 10x Bottleneck Test
makes10xFaster.description: Whether this initiative eliminates a bottleneck by 10x or more

impact.label: Impact
impact.description: Business value and strategic importance of the initiative

rubric.1-3: No visible impact on strategic goals or customer experience
rubric.4-6: Partial improvement; incremental value but not transformative
rubric.7-10: Direct value creation; eliminates a top-3 constraint or 10x improvement

feasibility.label: Feasibility
feasibility.description: Technical and organizational ability to deliver

rubric.7-10: Clear path; dependencies resolved or minimal

scalability.label: Scalability
scalability.description: Ability to scale autonomously without human bottlenecks

mcpDataFields.description: Fields populated via MCP (Atlassian Jira) integration

primaryBottleneck.description: The primary workflow bottleneck this initiative addresses

options: Data exists but siloed across systems
dataReadiness.description: Current state of data availability for the initiative

linkedDependencies.description: Other initiatives this depends on or unlocks

activeTime.description: Hours of active work in the workflow

waitTime.description: Hours of wait/idle time in the workflow (systemic roadblock)

suggestedScores.description: AI-suggested IFS scores based on Jira data analysis

scoringEngine.description: Variables and formulas used in the IFS scoring calculation

enablementBonus.description: Impact bonus for Enablement initiatives that unlock 2+ Activation use cases

hasStrategicBonus.description: Additional +1 Impact bonus if initiative aligns with strategic focus

feasibilityPenalty.description: Feasibility penalty when a required enabler is Stalled or Missing

adjustedImpact.description: Impact score after applying bonuses, capped at 10

adjustedFeasibility.description: Feasibility score after applying blocker penalty, minimum 1

frictionRatio.description: Percentage of cycle time spent in wait states (systemic roadblock)

contextAffinity.description: How well the initiative description aligns with organizational context

certaintyScore.description: Confidence level in the archetype classification

blockerDetection.description: Logic for detecting infrastructure blockers that affect Feasibility

archetypeClassification.description: Strategic archetype classification based on IFS scores

archetypes.name: Transformer
archetypes.description: High impact, feasibility, and scalability. Ship immediately.

archetypes.name: The Foundation
archetypes.description: Critical enablement work. Invest in infrastructure first.

archetypes.name: Quick Win
archetypes.description: High feasibility with moderate impact. Build momentum.

archetypes.name: The Experiment
archetypes.description: Moderate potential. Time-box exploration to validate.

archetypes.name: Money Pit
archetypes.description: Easy to build but won't scale. Defer or redesign.

archetypes.name: The Noise
archetypes.description: Low value across all dimensions. Discard.

evaluationOrder: The Foundation (enablement with high I/S, low F)

demoInitiatives.description: Pre-configured demo scenarios for presentation mode

humanOverride.overrideHistory: array - Log of all score overrides with reasons

jiraSync.isSyncingToJira: boolean - Loading state for sync operation

scoring.mcpOriginalScores: object - Original AI-suggested scores for comparison
